experiments.decision: Keep legacy production scoring unchanged. Preserve support-dependent hierarchy in research. Reject promotion of double bottom; continue observing higher low and Doji without score; retain support bullish engulfing and FVG 50% hold as candidates requiring larger forward samples and refined support/FVG definitions.
